steps.name: carry-core
steps.summary: Added src/core/time/carry.ts (+carry.test.ts) — pure carry-over logic exporting shiftPlannedToDate (grid-aware date move preserving clock+duration), carryOverNode (shift + carryCount++ + status 'carried'), findOverdueUncarried (idempotent past-due sweep filter); reuses day.ts grid-boundary helpers, no UI/DB imports.

steps.name: action-x-carry
steps.summary: CalendarBlock.tsx: Action ghost ✕ now carries the task to the next day via carryOverNode(node, addDays(selectedDate, 1)) through the existing optimistic useUpdateNode (no direct fetch); aria-label/title → 'Carry to tomorrow'. Removed all 'dropped' display paths — the line-through title style, the ↺ restore button branch, and CalendarGrid.tsx's `action && status==='dropped'` Action-column filter. Plan ✕ (removeNode) and Action real-block ✕ (clear actual) untouched.
